Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the ask: we agreed a technical deep dive with our ML/Infra engineers to validate serving architecture, latency/throughput expectations, and integration requirements. We recommend a 60–90 minute session.

Proposed objectives for the session (we can trim if needed):
- Run through QuantaPulse production workload and SLOs (latency targets, concurrency)
- Model variants and quantization strategy we recommend for cost/latency tradeoffs
- Deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and networking/ingress patterns
- Security/compliance checklist (data flow, retention, access controls)
- Next steps / mutual action items (POC plan or pilot sizing)

Availability from our side (PST):
- Tue Aug 3: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed Aug 4: 09:30–11:00 or 13:00–14:30
- Thu Aug 5: 11:00–12:30

Can you share which of those windows work for your infra/ops and product leads, and who will attend? Also attaching a short proposed agenda and a place to drop any security questions you want us to pre-read.

Attachments: Redwood-proposed-agenda.pdf (3p)

If none of those times match, tell me 2–3 times that work and we’ll prioritize. We’ll loop Ben (infra lead) and Marissa (solutions engineer) on the deep dive.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
